- Wed, Dec 2, 14:00–14:45 PT

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — a couple slot options for next week

Hi Sergio — thanks for the follow up and the one-pager.

Quick update from our side: our product org just locked a hard Q4 launch window and leadership has reassigned several engineering and product resources away from experimental integrations for the next two quarters. Practically, that means we need to deprioritize the inference POC for the moment and release any scheduled demo slots. We also have several folks traveling the first two weeks of December, which complicates scheduling.

We definitely want to revisit this after the launch (likely early Q2). Can you do two things for now?

1) Release the demo slot — we won't be able to host the full technical walkthrough while the team is focused on launch.
2) Keep us in a light nurture cadence — a single check-in in ~8–10 weeks would be great to reassess priorities.

Appreciate the flexibility — we liked what we saw in the one-pager and want to keep the door open.

Best,
Carmen Ruiz
Product Manager, Novacorp
carmen.ruiz@novacorp.io
